text: Carpentry is an ancient craft that involves constructing and repairing structures using wood. This skilled trade begins with sanding, where rough surfaces are smoothed with fine-grit sandpaper to prepare the wood for further work. After sanding, carpenters move on to sawing, where they cut wood into the right dimensions for various applications. Once cut, the pieces are carefully placed and assembled to form complete structures. This foundational process of sanding and sawing is essential to the art and science of carpentry, ensuring that the final product is durable and functional.
